sites.name: Van Wert Reservoir Recreation Area
sites.description: Waterfront recreation area encompassing the City of Van Wert's two municipal water supply reservoirs. Features a 3.1-mile paved health trail loop, fishing access, boat launch, bird watching areas, and sledding hill. Includes child sites Reservoir 1 and Reservoir 2.
sites.location: S Washington St, Van Wert, OH 45891
sites.address: S Washington St, Van Wert, OH 45891
sites.features: ADA Accessible; Bird Viewing Area; Fishing Area; Parking Lot; Sledding Hill
sites.features_raw: ADA accessible path (health trail 3.1 mi paved loop); bird watching; fishing access; parking; sledding hill; boat launch permit ($20/2yr); city water supply reservoirs
sites.notes: Parent of VNW-S-008 (Reservoir 1), VNW-S-009 (Reservoir 2), VNW-T-002 (Health Trail), VNW-AP-001 (Boat Launch). Trail and AP excluded from features per §6.1.

sites.name: Van Wert Reservoir 1
sites.description: City of Van Wert municipal water supply reservoir. 61 acres of water surface with 1.2 miles of shoreline. ODNR manages fish stocking. Used for public fishing and non-motorized recreation.
sites.location: S Washington St, Van Wert, OH 45891
sites.features_raw: 61 acres of water surface; 1.2 miles of shoreline; ODNR fish stocking; public fishing; city water supply reservoir (ODNR lake map, surveyed 2014)
sites.notes: Child site of VNW-S-007. GPS_VERIFY_NEEDED: GPS centroid not yet confirmed. Acreage confirmed via ODNR lake survey 2014.

sites.features: ADA Accessible; Boat Ramp; Fishing Area
